dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: Hello, would you like to commission antique appraisal?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello. You are...?

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: I run an antique store, and I am the most reliable antique appraisal expert in Port Ormos.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: My grandfather was a well-renowned historian. The gift of antique appreciation runs in our family.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: You can definitely trust my eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: Be it the relics of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, or the accessories of the Goddess of Flowers, or even what King Deshret left amidst the desert, there is not a single thing that I cannot tell the authenticity of at first glance.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not right now.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: Sure, sure. Let me help next time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Greater Lord Rukkhadevata...

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: Ah... Though Greater Lord Rukkhadevata has long departed, she will always be the greatest deity of Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: She defended Sumeru from calamities and troubles and left us inexhaustible knowledge and treasures after her death.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: So, usually, when I see an antique related to Greater Lord, I do my best to buy it and add it to my collection.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: I run an antique store — they call me the most reliable antique appraisal expert in Port Ormos.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: My grandfather was a well-renowned historian, so the gift of antique appreciation runs in our family.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: As such, you can definitely trust my eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: Be it accessories of the Goddess of Flowers, or relics of the Dendro Archon, or perhaps even that which King Deshret might have left amidst the desert sands, there is not one that can escape my appraising eye.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Dendro Archon...

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: *sigh* The Dendro Archon will always be our greatest god. The Akademiya's conduct up till now has been simply disgraceful.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: She defended us from such calamities and left us an inexhaustible store of wisdom and treasure...

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: So, usually, when I see an antique related to her, I will do my best to buy it and add it to my collection.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: Ah, I let you win, but you're pretty capable.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: Haha, playing cards is just like looking at antiques, if you're not careful you'll be cheated, so you always have to stay alert...
